New Storybook folder on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`, for Marcel's own manual testing/confirmation against a literal Jira AC list — not a shipped-feature deliverable, so keep annotations factual and descriptive only. Do not editorialize about which ACs the code does or doesn't satisfy — just cite the AC text and render the matching state; Marcel will judge each one himself.

**Create:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/acCoverage/index.stories.tsx`

**Mirror the existing sibling folder's conventions exactly** — read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx` in full first. Copy its patterns: local `PRIMARY_IMAGE`/`HOVER_IMAGE`/`SIZES` fixture consts (byte-identical values), the `LiveSizeSelectionCard` wrapper (for live size-chip interactivity on `plp`/`wishlist` stories), the `widthDecorator` helper, the `HOME_BASE`/`PLP_BASE`/`WISHLIST_BASE` args objects, the `MemoryRouter` meta-level decorator, and the `fn()` action-spy convention. This is deliberate, approved duplication (same fixture data as `nodeCoverage` and the main `index.stories.tsx`) — do not try to import from either sibling file or reintroduce a shared fixtures module.

**`meta.title`:** `'Commerce/ZimmProductCard/AC Coverage'`

**Create exactly 21 named story exports, one per AC line below, using these exact export names (mirroring the Jira AC list's own grouping and numbering so Marcel can check them off 1:1).** For each, the JSDoc comment directly above the export must quote the AC's exact given text verbatim, then state which Figma node(s)/variation/state renders it. Do NOT add any commentary about whether the AC is satisfied or contradicted — just the AC text, the state being shown, and (for hover-dependent ACs) a plain instruction on what to hover and what to look for. This file is Marcel's own judgment tool, not a verdict.

### Core Component
- `Core_1_PrimaryImageAlwaysDisplayed` — AC: "Given a product is passed to the card component, when it renders, then the primary product image is always displayed regardless of variation." Render the PLP default card (reuse `PLP_BASE`). Note in the comment that this same property is independently visible in every other story in this file (Home/PLP/Wishlist all render `primaryImage` unconditionally) since `primaryImage` is a required, non-optional prop on `ZimmProductCardBaseProps`.
- `Core_2_NoPageSpecificLogic` — AC: "Given the component is built as a PWA component, when imported into any page surface, then it renders correctly without page-specific logic embedded in the component itself." Render the PLP default card again. Note in the comment that this component takes every value as a prop and calls no data-fetching or page-context hook — the fact it renders correctly here, inside Storybook with zero real page/route/data layer around it (only the `MemoryRouter` this file's own `Link` rendering requires), is itself the demonstration.

### PLP variation
- `PLP_1_DefaultState` — AC: "Given the card renders on PLP, when it is in the default state, then the image, name, badge, price (incl. was/now), and cart icon are visible." Render PLP default, desktop width (288px), with both `currentPrice` and `originalPrice` set (e.g. `currentPrice: '$595.00', originalPrice: '$795.00'`) so the was/now treatment is visible, not just current price.
- `PLP_2_HoverSizeSelectorPriceImage` — AC: "Given the card renders on PLP, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the size selector becomes visible and the price disappears and the tile image switches from the item/flat photo to the model photo." Render PLP default, desktop width, with `hoverImage` set. Comment: "Hover the card in the canvas to see: price disappear, the size-chip row appear in its place, and the image crossfade to the model photo."
- `PLP_3_HoverArrows` — AC: "Given the card renders on PLP, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the arrows appear for the shopper to click through the product images." Render PLP default, desktop width, with a 3-image `images` array (reuse the gallery pattern — three colour-distinct data-URI SVGs, same style as `PRIMARY_IMAGE`/`HOVER_IMAGE`, add one more with fill `#454545`). Comment: "Hover the card to see prev/next arrows appear over the image."
- `PLP_4_MobileNoSizeSelector` — AC: "Given the card renders on PLP, when on mobile, then the size selector is not displayed." Render PLP default, mobile width (179px).
- `PLP_5_OutOfStock` — AC: "Given a product is out of stock, when the card renders, then the cart is greyed out and a notify me link appears on hover instead of price." Render PLP with `isUnavailable: true, onNotifyMe: fn()`, desktop width. Comment: "Hover the card to see the notify-me link's behaviour relative to price."

### Home page variation
- `Home_1_DefaultState` — AC: "Given the card renders on home page, when it is in the default state, then the image and name are displayed." Render Home default, desktop width.
- `Home_2_HoverArrows` — AC: "Given the card renders on home page, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the arrows appear for the shopper to click through the product images." Render Home with a 3-image gallery (same pattern as `PLP_3`), desktop width. Comment: "Hover to see arrows appear."
- `Home_3_HoverPrice` — AC: "Given the card renders on home page, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the price (incl. was/now) appears." Render Home default with `currentPrice`+`originalPrice` both set, desktop width. Comment: "Hover to see price (was/now) appear."
- `Home_4_Mobile` — AC: "Given the card renders on home page, when on mobile, then the user only sees the image and name." Render Home default, mobile width.

### Wishlist variation
- `Wishlist_1_DefaultState` — AC: "Given the card renders on the wishlist, when it is in the default state, then the image, cart icon, name, colour, size, badge, and price (incl. was/now) are displayed." Render Wishlist default (reuse `WISHLIST_BASE`) with `originalPrice` also set, desktop width.
- `Wishlist_2_RemoveCta` — AC: "Given the card renders on the wishlist, then there is a remove ('x') cta on the top right." Render Wishlist default, desktop width.
- `Wishlist_3_HoverImageSwap` — AC: "Given the card renders on wishlist, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the tile image switches from the item/flat photo to the model photo." Render Wishlist default with `hoverImage` set, desktop width. Comment: "Hover to see the image crossfade."
- `Wishlist_4_HoverArrows` — AC: "Given the card renders on wishlist, when on desktop and the user hovers, then the arrows appear for the shopper to click through the product images." Render Wishlist with a 3-image gallery, desktop width. Comment: "Hover to see arrows appear."

### Recently Viewed Full History variation
State plainly in a comment above this whole section: these five ACs are declared identical to PLP's own ("same behavior as PLP card") and render via `variation: 'plp'` — same as every other part of this codebase treats it, not a fourth variation. Reuse `PLP_BASE` for all five, same as the `PLP_*` stories above, just under these names so Marcel can check them against the Jira list's own separate RVFH numbering:
- `RVFH_1_DefaultState` — AC 1, same render as `PLP_1_DefaultState`.
- `RVFH_2_HoverSizeSelectorPriceImage` — AC 2, same render as `PLP_2_HoverSizeSelectorPriceImage`.
- `RVFH_3_HoverArrows` — AC 3, same render as `PLP_3_HoverArrows`.
- `RVFH_4_MobileNoSizeSelector` — AC 4, same render as `PLP_4_MobileNoSizeSelector`.
- `RVFH_5_OutOfStock` — AC 5, same render as `PLP_5_OutOfStock`.

### Variation extensibility
- `Extensibility_1_ConfigurableWithoutRestructuring` — AC: "Given a new style is introduced in future (e.g. Search), when added to the component, then it can be configured without restructuring the base component." This isn't a visual state — render a documentation placeholder matching this file's sibling `nodeCoverage/index.stories.tsx`'s own `Hero_ExcludedNotInScope` placeholder pattern (a dashed-border `Box` with explanatory text), not a real card. State in the placeholder text and the JSDoc comment: the actual proof is `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s `VARIATION_CONFIG` table (every layout decision keyed by `variation`, zero `switch`/`if` on it anywhere in the render body — grep-verifiable) plus two `@ts-expect-error` compile-time cases in `zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` proving the type system enforces per-variation field requirements. Point to those two files by path rather than reproducing their content here.

**After building, run `npx tsc --noEmit`** (must be clean) **and report back exactly which stories needed a 3-image gallery fixture added** (so I know if you added a shared gallery const or repeated it per-story — either is fine, just tell me which). Do not run the full test suite (stories aren't executed by Vitest). Do not stage, do not commit.

244	    Omit<ZimmProductCardWishlistVariation, 'variation'> &
245	    Omit<ZimmProductCardHomeVariation, 'variation'>

250	  showAttributes: boolean;
251	  showSizeChips: boolean;
252	  /** PLP/Wishlist: price is visible by default and hides on hover. */
253	  hoverHidesPrice: boolean;
254	  /** Home only: price is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
255	  hoverRevealsPrice: boolean;
256	  /** PLP/Wishlist: the size-chip picker is hidden by default and reveals on hover. */
257	  hoverRevealsSizeSelector: boolean;
258	  showRemove: boolean;

260	   *  instance has the bag icon's `Icons` frame `hidden="true"`, unlike Desktop and unlike

262	   *  width concern, not a hover one — see zimmProductCard.css.ts's own responsive rule. */
263	  hideBagOnMobile: boolean;
264	  /** Wishlist only (found during the follow-up full-sweep visual audit against every variant x
265	   *  state node): unlike PLP's unconditional `hideBagOnMobile`, Wishlist's Mobile Card-content
266	   *  instance shows the bag icon when available (`40002187:58470`) and hides it
267	   *  (`Icons` frame `hidden="true"`) only when unavailable (`40002187:58473`) — narrower than
268	   *  `hideBagOnMobile`, and combined with it (not replacing it) in the `bagHiddenOnMobile`
269	   *  derivation below, since the two are mutually exclusive per variation today but there is no
270	   *  reason to assume that stays true forever. */
271	  hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: boolean;

275	   * Allows `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s primary/hover image crossfade for this variation. Suppressed
276	   * on Home per Dani Rivett's scope note, overriding the AC's unconditional framing — see the
277	   * module docblock's "Hover image-swap on Home" note. `false` here means a supplied
278	   * `hoverImage` is simply never swapped to, regardless of pointer capability.
279	   */

284	 * The extensibility AC's actual mechanism: every layout/visibility decision this organism makes
285	 * reads from this table, keyed by `variation` — adding a future variation means adding a union
286	 * member above and one row here, touching no JSX. `index.tsx`'s render body contains no

291	  home: {
292	    showBag: false,
293	    showAttributes: false,
294	    showSizeChips: false,
295	    hoverHidesPrice: false,
296	    hoverRevealsPrice: true,
297	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: false,
298	    showRemove: false,
299	    hideBagOnMobile: false,
300	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
301	    showBadge: false,
302	    showHoverImageSwap: false,
303	  },
304	  plp: {
305	    showBag: true,
306	    showAttributes: false,
307	    showSizeChips: true,
308	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
309	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
310	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
311	    showRemove: false,
312	    hideBagOnMobile: true,
313	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: false,
314	    showBadge: true,
315	    showHoverImageSwap: true,
316	  },

318	    showBag: true,
319	    showAttributes: true,
320	    showSizeChips: true,
321	    hoverHidesPrice: true,
322	    hoverRevealsPrice: false,
323	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector: true,
324	    showRemove: true,

326	    hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable: true,

347	 * confirmed Figma variation matrix and this component's own recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) for
348	 * the stretched-link and hover-reveal mechanics that live entirely in CSS, not in this render
349	 * body — both children are always rendered in full, with every one of their own sub-parts; CSS

353	 */

356	    id,
357	    href,
358	    name,
359	    headingLevel,
360	    primaryImage,
361	    hoverImage,
362	    images,
363	    currentPrice,
364	    originalPrice,
365	    isPriceLoading,
366	    isUnavailable,
367	    onNotifyMe,
368	    badge,
369	    variation,
370	  } = props;
371	
372	  const { onAddToBag, sizeChipValues, selectedSizeChipValue, onSizeChipSelect, colour, size, onRemove } =
373	    props as ZimmProductCardVariationFields;
374	
375	  const intl = useIntl();
376	  const config = VARIATION_CONFIG[variation];
377	
378	  // Both conditions required — an organism that sets isUnavailable without a real callback
379	  // should not show a dead notify-me button. Mirrors ZimmProductCardContent's own
380	  // showNotifyMeButton co-requirement.
381	  const showNotifyMe = Boolean(isUnavailable) && Boolean(onNotifyMe);
382	
383	  // Fix C (SFCC-236 Step 6 visual audit): confirmed against the real Figma Default+Hover
384	  // instances for every variation × Unavailable=True (including the Mobile/no-hover variants,
385	  // which show the only state a touch pointer ever sees) that `isUnavailable` suppresses the
386	  // size-selector hover-swap entirely — there is nothing to pick for an out-of-stock item, so
387	  // price stays visible on hover instead of being replaced. Home's own hover-reveals-price
388	  // behaviour is untouched by this — Home's Unavailable Hover reference (node 40002163:39990)
389	  // still reveals price on hover exactly as the in-stock case does; only the PLP/Wishlist
390	  // hide-and-swap needs suppressing.
391	  //
392	  // Suppressing `hoverRevealsSizeSelector` alone is not enough to reproduce that reference: it
393	  // only stops the organism adding its OWN hide/reveal pair, which leaves the size-chip wrapper
394	  // at Content's own natural (visible) default — briefly shipped that way mid-fix and caught by
395	  // re-checking the real Storybook render against Figma, which confirms size chips stay hidden
396	  // in BOTH states when unavailable, not just "not swapped in on hover". `sizeSelectorUnavailable`
397	  // carries that permanent hide separately, unconditional (not gated by hover-capability at all —
398	  // this isn't a pointer-type concern, unlike everything else in this recipe).
399	  //
400	  // Follow-up (full-sweep visual audit against every variant x state node, not just the sampled
401	  // set the first pass checked): `sizeSelectorUnavailable` ALSO drives a mobile-only price hide
402	  // in the recipe now (Fix F) — confirmed via `get_metadata` that Mobile PLP/Wishlist Unavailable
403	  // hide price and show notify-me in its place (`40002163:41488`, `40002187:58475`), the OPPOSITE
404	  // of Desktop's additive treatment (price stays, notify-me is simply added on hover). Nothing
405	  // extra is computed here for it — the recipe reads the same `sizeSelectorUnavailable` boolean

407	  // the same PLP/Wishlist-and-unavailable case.
408	  const hoverHidesPrice = config.hoverHidesPrice && !isUnavailable;
409	  const hoverRevealsSizeSelector = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && !isUnavailable;
410	  const sizeSelectorUnavailable = config.hoverRevealsSizeSelector && Boolean(isUnavailable);
411	
412	  // Fix G (same follow-up audit): Wishlist-only. `hideBagOnMobile` alone only covers PLP's own
413	  // unconditional mobile hide; Wishlist's bag stays visible on mobile UNLESS unavailable
414	  // (`40002187:58470` vs `40002187:58473`). Combined into one boolean here rather than exposing

416	  // not why.
417	  const bagHiddenOnMobile = config.hideBagOnMobile || (config.hideBagOnMobileWhenUnavailable && Boolean(isUnavailable));

419	  const removeLabel = config.showRemove ? intl.formatMessage(messages.removeFromWishlist, { name }) : undefined;

424	    hoverRevealsPrice: config.hoverRevealsPrice,
425	    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
426	    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
427	    // Same Fix C audit: notify-me is hover-gated on hover-capable devices (hidden by default,

447	        badge={resolvedBadge}
448	        onRemove={onRemove}
449	        removeLabel={removeLabel}

451	      <ZimmProductCardContent
452	        name={name}
453	        headingLevel={headingLevel}
454	        href={href}
455	        currentPrice={currentPrice}
456	        originalPrice={originalPrice}
457	        isPriceLoading={isPriceLoading}
458	        showAttributes={config.showAttributes}
459	        colour={colour}

462	        isUnavailable={isUnavailable}
463	        onAddToBag={onAddToBag}
464	        showSizeChips={config.showSizeChips}
465	        sizeChipValues={sizeChipValues}
466	        selectedSizeChipValue={selectedSizeChipValue}
467	        onSizeChipSelect={onSizeChipSelect}
468	        showNotifyMe={showNotifyMe}
469	        onNotifyMe={onNotifyMe}
470	      />
471	    </chakra.div>
472	  );
473	};
